evals.prompt: Before the security and API reviews start, inventory every endpoint, client route and background job in evals/files/multi-stack-repo. It has a .NET API, an Express service, a Django app and an Angular front end. I just want the facts per endpoint, not findings.
evals.expected_output: inventory_endpoints.py writes endpoints.json, endpoints.md and endpoints.probe.json under audit/evidence/audit-endpoint-inventory/. The stacks resolve to dotnet, node-express, python-django and angular. Each record has a stable id. The planted facts are recorded as facts: login and health are explicit-anonymous, GET /api/accounts/{id} has an ownership check and /statement has none, GET /api/accounts is an unpaginated collection and /page is paginated, /profile exposes UserProfileDto.PasswordHash, POST /api/orders has three sequential outbound calls, /admin/users is a client route with an inherited guard, and nightly-statements is a Hangfire job with no identity context. Nothing is called a finding and no severity is assigned.
expectations: endpoints.json has kind http records for POST /api/accounts/login and GET /api/health with auth.source explicit-anonymous
The GET /api/accounts/{id} record has ownership.check yes and the GET /api/accounts/{id}/statement record has ownership.check no
The GET /api/accounts record has response.pagination.status no and the GET /api/accounts/page record has yes
The GET /api/accounts/{id}/profile record lists UserProfileDto.PasswordHash in response.sensitive_fields
The POST /api/orders record from backend-node has three outbound.calls and outbound.sequential true
A client-route record exists for /admin/users whose auth.client_guards includes an inherited canActivate guard
A job record with framework hangfire, job.name nightly-statements and job.identity_context no exists
Every record has an id starting with ep-
The response does not assign severities or call any record a finding

evals.prompt: I need input files for the authz probe and the k6 generator for evals/files/multi-stack-repo. Give me whatever the endpoint inventory produces for them and tell me which endpoints carry tenant or user identifiers.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs inventory_endpoints.py and points to endpoints.probe.json, explains that its rows carry method, path, route, auth_required, roles, ownership_check (Y/N/-/?), id_params, operation, kind (read/write) and weight so authz_probe.py, tenant_probe.py and loadtest_plan.py read it directly, and lists tenant or user identifier parameters: tenantId in the route of GET /api/tenants/{tenantId}/usage, company_id in the query of GET /api/invoices/, branchId in the query of GET /api/accounts, and orderId/userId facts on the Express order lookup.
expectations: endpoints.probe.json exists and every row has method, path, route, auth_required, ownership_check, id_params, operation, kind and weight
The probe row for GET /api/accounts/{id}/statement has ownership_check N and id_params mapping id to account
The response identifies tenantId as a route parameter of GET /api/tenants/{tenantId}/usage
The response identifies company_id as a query parameter of the Django invoice list
The response says the probe needs a base URL and test tokens and does not claim any probe was run

evals.prompt: Run the endpoint inventory on evals/files/multi-stack-repo. For our API review I need, per endpoint: is it paginated, is the request validated, does the response expose credential-type fields, and does its error shape match the rest of the API? Which fields in endpoints.json give me each of those, and where do the sensitive-field names come from?
evals.expected_output: The inventory is run and the contract is cited: pagination is response.pagination.status, validation is validation.status, exposed credential fields are response.sensitive_fields (classified by audit-sensitive-data-catalog, credential and secret categories), the raw route is path_raw, and error-shape agreement is errors.consistent_with_majority. Evidence strings quote code markers verbatim, for example .Skip(.
expectations: The response maps pagination to response.pagination.status
The response maps validation to validation.status
The response maps exposed credential fields to response.sensitive_fields
The response says sensitive fields come from audit-sensitive-data-catalog
The response cites references/endpoint-inventory-contract.md

evals.prompt: evals/files/metaframework-repo has a Next.js app, a Nuxt app and a Remix app. List every server handler, server action and middleware with its facts (path, method, auth, pagination) and tell me what goes into the probe file. Facts only, no findings.
evals.expected_output: inventory_endpoints.py resolves the stacks to react (web-next, web-remix) and vue (web-nuxt) and records: GET /api/orders/{id} as nextjs-route with the (shop) route group dropped, auth yes via getServerSession and ownership yes; GET and POST /api/invoices as nextjs-pages-api, one record per req.method branch, no auth, the GET unpaginated and the POST validated with zod; a server-action record POST web-next/src/app/orders/actions.ts#cancelOrder with auth yes; GET /api/orders/{id} as nuxt-server-route from [id].get.ts with auth no and source none; a middleware record for web-nuxt/server/middleware/log.ts; the Remix loader GET /orders/{id} with returns_collection yes and pagination no, and the action POST /orders/{id} with auth yes. endpoints.probe.json has the six http rows and neither the server action nor the middleware. No severities are assigned.
expectations: endpoints.json has a kind http record with framework nextjs-route, method GET, path /api/orders/{id} and auth.required yes with auth.source handler call
web-next/src/pages/api/invoices/index.ts produces two nextjs-pages-api records, GET and POST /api/invoices, and no ANY record
A kind server-action record exists with method POST, path web-next/src/app/orders/actions.ts#cancelOrder and auth.required yes
The nuxt-server-route record GET /api/orders/{id} from web-nuxt/server/api/orders/[id].get.ts has auth.required no and auth.source none
The remix-route loader record GET /orders/{id} has response.returns_collection yes and response.pagination.status no, and the action record is POST /orders/{id} with auth.required yes
A kind middleware record exists for web-nuxt/server/middleware/log.ts
endpoints.probe.json has six rows and no row for the server action or the middleware
The response does not assign severities or call any record a finding

evals.prompt: I'm running the ORM audit's unbounded-endpoint step on evals/files/metaframework-repo. Which handlers load a whole collection without paging, and are the Next.js server actions part of that list?
evals.expected_output: The skill runs inventory_endpoints.py and applies the audit-orm-query-and-data-access filter (kind http, materializing_calls present, paging_seen false). It lists the Remix loader GET /orders/{id} in web-remix/app/routes/orders.$id.tsx (prisma.orderLine.findMany) and GET /api/invoices in web-next/src/pages/api/invoices/index.ts (prisma.invoice.findMany). It explains that server actions are kind server-action records with no URL, so the kind == http filter leaves them out and they are not in endpoints.probe.json; cancelOrder has no materialising call in any case.
expectations: The response lists GET /orders/{id} (the Remix loader, prisma.orderLine.findMany) as a collection handler without paging
The response lists GET /api/invoices (the Next.js pages/api GET branch) as a collection handler without paging
The response does not list the Next.js or Nuxt GET /api/orders/{id} handlers as unbounded
The response says server actions are kind server-action records that the kind == http filter excludes and that are absent from endpoints.probe.json
The response cites the audit-orm-query-and-data-access filter or the endpoints.json fields materializing_calls and paging_seen
